preamble:
Dear Freedom of Information Coordinator,

This is a request for records under the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (MFIPPA). The $5.00 application fee is enclosed / has been paid.

I request electronic copies of records where they exist in electronic form. Please provide final versions of records; I am not requesting drafts. If any portion of a responsive record is withheld, please cite the specific exemption relied upon and disclose the remainder as required by s. 4(2). If estimated fees will exceed $25, please provide a fee estimate and contact me before proceeding — I am open to narrowing the scope of this request to reduce fees or processing time.
closing:
Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response within the 30-day statutory period.

Sincerely,
[Name]
[Mailing address]
[Email] · [Phone]

items: Records sufficient to identify the number and locations (street address or intersection) of any fixed (non-vehicle-mounted) automated licence plate recognition (ALPR) cameras installed, piloted, or approved for installation by the Toronto Police Service, from January 1, 2023 to present.
The final Privacy Impact Assessment(s) for the ALPR program, including any updates prepared for the integration of ALPR into the in-car camera system completed in 2024–2025.

Records showing the currently configured retention periods in the ALPR system for (a) non-hit plate reads, (b) hit records, and (c) associated audit logs — for example, a system configuration export, administrative settings document, or governance procedure stating the configured values.

Any agreements, memoranda of understanding, or system configuration records governing the sharing of ALPR data with other police services or agencies, including whether any vendor cross-agency data-sharing features are enabled or disabled.
Final audit or compliance reports concerning access to or searches of ALPR data, from January 1, 2024 to present.
Records sufficient to identify which initiatives funded under the 'AI Operationalization' line of the 2026 operating/capital budget involve ALPR or licence-plate data.

submission.how: No online portal — the only service without one. File in person at HQ (pay by debit/credit, no cheque needed) or by mail with a $5 cheque to 'Toronto Police Service'.
submission.address: Information Privacy Section, 4th Floor, 40 College Street, Toronto, ON M5G 2J3
submission.inPerson: HQ main-floor lobby, 40 College St — 7:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri (closed Wed). Debit, Visa, Mastercard accepted in person.
